closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, vitamin B12, and zinc, but the biggest weaknesses are low potassium, saturated fat, and low vitamin D. It's good for blood and oxygen support, muscles and strength sports, and immune support because vitamin B12 and iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, the protein section supports repair and maintenance, and zinc helps support the immune system.
